tagline: macOS parallel agent runner with worktrees.
keyFeatures: Unified review interface — diff & merge changes across agents
Runs multiple Claude Code / Codex agents in parallel
Local-first — runs entirely on your Mac
Free beyond existing Claude Code / Codex subscriptions
limitations: macOS (Apple Silicon) only — no Windows / Linux
Not an SDD tool — it's an agent runner
No enterprise features (Jira, signed commits, multi-user)
Intel Mac support still in development
